text:
jordana: Heads-up — CI flagged a failing integration test in the sampleapp: batch rerank calls are being rejected for dim mismatch. The test sent 512-dim vectors but the rerank route expects 768.

mike: Can you paste the failing test log? curious if the helper mutated shapes or if CI is using the wrong model alias. :mag:

jordana: Log snippet (sanitized): POST /api/rerank body: requests=[{id:q1, embedding=[0.12,0.03,.../*512 floats*/]}], model=\"r1-open-embed-512\"; response 400: \"dim_mismatch: got=512 expected=768\"

sam: Looks like config drift — CI image uses model alias r1-rerank-v1 which is pinned to the 768 variant. Two root causes I can think of: the local sampleapp default is the 512 quantized embedder or our batch helper has a normalization pass that reduces precision and collapses to 512-length float16 vector.

lina: Parity note: Go and Node SDKs currently auto-pad/extend vectors to the server-expected length, Python raises. That inconsistency is a big DX footgun.

mike: Short-term fixes: (1) make the batch helper validate dims and fail loudly in CI, (2) add a lint/pre-commit hook (vector-shape-lint) that checks embedding_dim in model metadata vs sampleapp config, (3) surface model.metadata.embedding_dim in all SDKs.

jordana: Proposed lint rule: if sampleapp config.model_embedding_dim != model.metadata.embedding_dim then fail CI with an informative message and remediation link. Failing message should show both values.

sam: Backend-side we could accept an optional header X-Embedding-Dim to explicitly indicate the client's vector length. Server can then either route to a compatible reranker, or return an error with suggestions: candidate models and a curl example. E.g., curl -H \"X-Embedding-Dim: 512\" ...

lina: Also discovered a retry/idempotency issue in CI: the test harness retried timed-out batches without idempotency keys and rerank inserted duplicate scoring rows (we saw duplicate score timestamps). For scoring flows that's dangerous. Let's add Idempotency-Key header on batch calls by default and have server dedupe identical payloads for a short window.

mike: Agreed. Also, add a lightweight compatibility shim in the sampleapp that normalizes field names (vector, embedding, embeddings) into a single canonical shape before sending to rerank. We should encourage SDKs to standardize to embedding (single) / embeddings (batch).

jordana: I'll open a PR in sampleapp that adds: (a) dim validation step before batching, (b) vector-shape-lint pre-commit hook, (c) compatibility shim. Pseudo for the validator:
```python
expected = model_meta['embedding_dim']
for i, v in enumerate(batch):
    if len(v) != expected:
        raise AssertionError(f"embedding at index {i} length {len(v)} != expected {expected}. Set pad_mode or pick a compatible model.")
```

sam: Nice. Also add a CI job matrix that runs the sampleapp against both the 512 and 768 embed variants so we catch mismatches earlier.

lina: For SDK parity: create a single spec doc that defines behavior for dim mismatch (error vs pad vs trim), idempotency headers, and response field names. Then implement small convergent patches in each SDK.

mike: Ops ask: server error messages should be machine-friendly. Example: {error: \"dim_mismatch\", got:512, expected:768, help:\"use model r1-open-embed-768 or set pad_mode\"}. That way SDKs can map to a specific exception and provide actionable CLI fixes.

jordana: I'll include that shape in the PR. Also adding a sampleapp integration test that intentionally sends a 512 vector to the 768 reranker and asserts we get the dim_mismatch error with candidate recommendations. This will prevent regressions.

ci-bot: Test run 445: added failure for embed-dim lint; see build logs at ci.redwood/445.

devx-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-3201: \"embed dim lint + sampleapp CI guard + idempotency for batch rerank\" linking this thread.

mike: One more UX/observability note: add metrics for \"dim_mismatch_count\" and a tracing tag with model_alias and client_declared_dim so SRE can triage quickly.

lina: Also document in onboarding: a short troubleshooting checklist (1) check sampleapp config.model_embedding_dim, (2) curl with X-Embedding-Dim, (3) run vector-shape-lint locally, (4) enable pad_mode if intentionally using quantized vectors.

sam: Thanks — follow-ups: I'll add server-side support for X-Embedding-Dim routing and the better error payload.

jordana: Thanks all. I'll PR the sampleapp changes + add the CI job. Ping when server side pieces land so I can update tests.

mike: Great. Closing loop: once SDK spec is drafted, we should run a short compatibility patch release across Node, Python, Go. :shipit:

lina: On it. :thumbsup:

jordana: Resolved for now.
